profile.name: International Trade Administration
profile.description: Commerce administration responsible for the American AI Exports Program.

summary.text: The International Trade Administration announced implementation of the American AI Exports Program in October 2025 and later invited proposals for industry-led full-stack American AI export packages. The program is described as selecting industry-led export packages covering AI hardware, software, models, and applications for promotion to countries and regions, with designated packages potentially receiving government advocacy, licensing review, coordination, and financing referrals. ITA also announced a 2024 roundtable on strategies to increase U.S. industry competitiveness and support commercialization of U.S.-produced AI-enabled medical technologies.
